sources.snippet: Ollaya shipped its first releases and launched on Hacker News as an Ollama-style runtime for decision models. v0.6.0 on September 25 added the Von, Kev and Qwen3Guard model families, an agent review preset and a redesigned macOS menu bar.

sources.snippet: Qwen3Guard is a series of safety moderation models built upon Qwen3 and trained on a dataset of 1.19 million prompts and responses labeled for safety. sources.title: Qwen3Guard Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: The results demonstrate that Generative Qwen3Guard outperforms existing state-of-the-art models in detecting unsafe prompts and responses across diverse languages. Meanwhile, Stream Qwen3Guard enables highly efficient real-time safety monitoring during generation, with only modest performance degradation compared with the Generative Qwen3Guard.
